title: Best AI Mobile App Builder for Education and Learning Apps in 2026
summary: We scored seven AI mobile app builders on the eight things that matter to a learning app: lessons, progress and streaks, quizzes, an AI tutor, reminders, subscriptions, and safe handling of young learners.
body_markdown:
Blink, at 72 out of 80, because it builds lessons, progress tracking, push reminders, RevenueCat plans, and an in-app AI tutor on one database. FlutterFlow is second at 52.


Yes. Blink apps can call 74 text models plus image and voice models and answer from your own documents with sources, so a tutor works inside each lesson with no API keys.


RevenueCat's 2026 data found Education favors annual plans, with 59 to 66% of plan volume in Education, Travel, and Shopping. Blink sets up both through RevenueCat.


Apple's Kids Category guideline says such apps must not include links out of the app, purchasing opportunities, or other distractions unless reserved for a designated area behind a parental gate.


Apple's guidelines let one-to-one real-time services such as tutoring use purchase methods other than in-app purchase, while one-to-few and one-to-many real-time services must use in-app purchase.
